svg.title: The regions’ values rose over 2005–2025, and the two ends of the order stayed the same
svg.desc: Slope chart: The regions’ values rose over 2005–2025, and the two ends of the order stayed the same: in 2005: East Asia & Pacific: 14.7%, Europe & Central Asia: 34.7%, Latin America & Caribbean: 16.6%, North America: 68.3%, South Asia: 2.1%, Sub-Saharan Africa: 2.0%, World: 15.6%; in 2025: East Asia & Pacific: 88.4%, Europe & Central Asia: 92.4%, Latin America & Caribbean: 83.7%, North America: 95.6%, South Asia: 67.8%, Sub-Saharan Africa: 35.7%, World: 73.6%.
